INSERT INTO TRAFFIC_LINK (SOURCE, AREA_CODE, LINK_ID, ROUTE_ID, ROAD_NAME, ST_NODE_NAME, ED_NODE_NAME, AXIS_DIR, DISTANCE_M, CENTER_DIST_M, CREATE_DT, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_DT, UPDATE_USER, DELETE_YN)
SELECT 'GITS', 'PYEONGCHON', j.LINK_ID, j.ROUTE_ID, j.ROAD_NAME, j.ST_NODE_NAME, j.ED_NODE_NAME, j.AXIS_DIR, j.DISTANCE_M, NULL, NOW(), 'SYSTEM', NOW(), 'SYSTEM', 0
FROM JSON_TABLE($1, "$[*]" COLUMNS (
  LINK_ID VARCHAR(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH "$.linkId",
  ROUTE_ID VARCHAR(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH "$.routeId",
  ROAD_NAME VARCHAR(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH "$.roadName",
  ST_NODE_NAME VARCHAR(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH "$.startNodeName",
  ED_NODE_NAME VARCHAR(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH "$.endNodeName",
  AXIS_DIR VARCHAR(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH "$.routeWay" NULL ON EMPTY,
  DISTANCE_M INT PATH "$.distanceM"
)) j
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE AREA_CODE = VALUES(AREA_CODE), ROUTE_ID = VALUES(ROUTE_ID), ROAD_NAME = VALUES(ROAD_NAME), ST_NODE_NAME = VALUES(ST_NODE_NAME), ED_NODE_NAME = VALUES(ED_NODE_NAME), AXIS_DIR = VALUES(AXIS_DIR), DISTANCE_M = VALUES(DISTANCE_M), CENTER_DIST_M = NULL, UPDATE_DT = NOW(), UPDATE_USER = 'SYSTEM', DELETE_YN = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS STALE_COUNT
FROM TRAFFIC_LINK t
WHERE t.SOURCE = 'GITS' AND t.DELETE_YN = 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM JSON_TABLE($1, "$[*]" COLUMNS (
      LINK_ID VARCHAR(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH "$.linkId"
    )) j
    WHERE j.LINK_ID = t.LINK_ID
  )

UPDATE TRAFFIC_LINK
SET DELETE_YN = 1, UPDATE_DT = NOW(), UPDATE_USER = 'SYSTEM'
WHERE SOURCE = 'GITS' AND DELETE_YN = 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM JSON_TABLE($1, "$[*]" COLUMNS (
      LINK_ID VARCHAR(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH "$.linkId"
    )) j
    WHERE j.LINK_ID = TRAFFIC_LINK.LINK_ID
  )
